governance.pre_repair_task: Task R8 - Downstream Gate / Optimization Repair

hard_claim_boundary.interpretation: Downstream evaluations are strictly synthetic gate assignment simulations and simulated operational scenarios.
hard_claim_boundary.ground_truth_justification: BTS On-Time dataset contains scheduled and realized departure/arrival clock times, flight numbers, and tail identifiers, but contains ZERO physical gate identifiers or pushback apron movement records. All gate topologies, nominal assignments, and turnaround buffers are synthetic research models.

regime_A_schedule_only.description: Plans gate allocations strictly according to published scheduled CRS_ARR_TIME.

regime_B_core_arrival_forecast.arrival_delay_input: Predicted arrival delay from approved Core Arrival point/probabilistic models
regime_B_core_arrival_forecast.description: Plans gate allocations using pre-registered predictions (Linear Baseline, Random Forest, HistGradientBoosting, XGBoost, Weighted Ensemble, P5 Quantile Median, P4 NGBoost).

regime_C_oracle_reference.description: Theoretical upper/reference bound with perfect future information. Research reference only; does not represent an operational forecasting system.

strictly_prohibited_inputs: Auxiliary departure delay predictions (p_dep_delay, y_dep_cls, dep_delay)
Weather features (METAR, wind, snow, precip, temp)
Actual operational outcomes from holdout year 2024

CONTACT_GATE.semantic_definition: Flight assigned to an available physical terminal contact gate.
CONTACT_GATE.cost_implication: Standard nominal reassignment penalty if gate differs from nominal plan.

REMOTE_STAND.semantic_definition: Flight assigned to a remote stand / overflow apron.
REMOTE_STAND.capacity: Infinite capacity (no pairwise conflict), incurs busing/towing operational penalty.

UNASSIGNED.semantic_definition: Flight left unassigned due to complete solver failure or infeasibility.
UNASSIGNED.cost_implication: Massive overflow penalty (2 * overflow_weight = 400.0); renders solution strictly infeasible.

independent_verifier.authority: Solvers cannot self-certify feasibility. An independent outside function audits all constraints.
verifications_performed: Pairwise contact gate overlap detection (including separation buffer)
Distinct state counting and unassigned detection
Realized post-hoc conflict detection under actual delays

integer_scaling.audited_terms: Decision costs only. Exogenous delay and risk costs are evaluated in common evaluator but omitted from CP-SAT decision variables to prevent integer scaling distortion.

CPSat.role: primary exact solver producing proved optimal or bounded solutions
CPSat.status_reporting_rule: Reports OPTIMAL strictly when solver status == cp_model.OPTIMAL and independent verifier certifies feasible.

SimulatedAnnealingRefinement.budget: T/2 seconds for CP-SAT incumbent + T/2 seconds for SA refinement, total compute <= T
SimulatedAnnealingRefinement.role: neighborhood local search starting from CP-SAT incumbent under equal compute
SimulatedAnnealingRefinement.superiority_rule: SA refinement must never be claimed as superior to an optimal CP-SAT solution.
